messages.subject: Can I use native Mysql interface?
parts:
For some reason I can't get the ODBC to play nice with Mysql (I'm working on it..)
How might I use the native Mysql interface? (which I do have working with the Mysql tools...
And I was able to read a table into a R variable...
How can I best emulate the nice ODBC interface so I can use the rest of Rattle?

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Can I use native Mysql interface?
parts:
For any dataset stored as a data frame in R you can load it into Rattle using the "R Dataset" optoin. So if you load the data into R using other R interfaces to MySQL, then you can load it into Rattle.

Regards,
Graham
